Usually it’s not a problem to apply while on a different visa , with this specific visa it might lead to delays , as many times misrad Hapnim refuses to open the case while the foreigner is in Israel. But you can read here and show them.
They might give here a tourist visa instead , once you applied. Be aware that it can take up to 1 year till the first visa and your partner won’t be able to work an can’t leave and re enter without permission (usually not issued)
Actually the wrong path was to apply for the working holiday visa in the first place instead of the partner visa.
